name: 市長と副市長の給料月額を引き上げ
summary: 現在、市長の給料月額は1,035,000円、副市長は895,000円です。この議案で、それぞれ1,060,000円、900,000円に改め、旅費の種類と額の決め方を、職員の旅費に関する条例に定める指定職職員の例に合わせます。改正後の旅費の規定は令和8年4月1日以降に出発する旅行に適用し、それより前に出発した旅行は従来の扱いです。
changes: 市長の給料月額を1,035,000円から1,060,000円に引き上げる
副市長の給料月額を895,000円から900,000円に引き上げる
旅費の種類を定め、額を職員の旅費に関する条例の指定職職員の例によるものにする
who: 市長・副市長などの常勤特別職職員
why: 市長等の給料月額及び旅費を改めるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Raises the monthly salaries of the mayor and deputy mayor
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Chofu City Ordinance on Salaries and Travel Expenses for the Mayor and Other Full-Time Special-Status Employees
en.summary: The mayor’s current monthly salary is ¥1,035,000, and the deputy mayor’s is ¥895,000. This bill changes them to ¥1,060,000 and ¥900,000, respectively, and aligns the types of travel expenses and how their amounts are determined with the rules for designated-position employees under the ordinance on travel expenses for city employees. The amended travel expense rules apply to trips departing on or after April 1, 2026. Trips departing before then will continue to be handled under the previous rules.
changes: Raises the mayor’s monthly salary from ¥1,035,000 to ¥1,060,000
Raises the deputy mayor’s monthly salary from ¥895,000 to ¥900,000
Sets the types of travel expenses and bases their amounts on the rules for designated-position employees under the ordinance on travel expenses for city employees
who: The mayor, deputy mayor and other full-time special-status employees
en.why: The city says this is to revise the monthly salaries and travel expenses of the mayor and others.
